sample: Thanks for calling the practice. I'm the digital assistant. This call is recorded for quality. How can I help?
Hi, I've had some knee pain for a couple of weeks. Could I book an appointment this week?
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me check availability. There's Wednesday at ten thirty in the morning. Or Thursday at three in the afternoon. Would either suit you?
Thursday at three, please. Actually, sorry, could we do Friday morning instead?
Of course. Friday the eighteenth of September at ten in the morning is available. Does that work?
Can I take your full name, please?
Priya Nair. That's Nair, N A I R.
Thanks, Priya. And a contact number?
It's zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, one two three.
Let me read that back. Zero seven seven zero zero; nine zero zero; one two three. Is that right?
Would you prefer your appointment confirmation by email or text?
Email, please. It's priya at example dot com.
That's priya at example dot com. Have I got that right?
You're booked for Friday the eighteenth of September, at ten in the morning. Your confirmation email will include the practice address and how to reschedule. Is there anything else you need?
